paragraphs.text: Mayfly terminal UI bundle for DeepSeek Harness
# Mayfly
English | 中文
Mayfly is an independent terminal frontend for DeepSeek Harness. The product runs as two processes:
a native dsh **Host** and an independent **TUI** connected through the official HTTP/WebSocket Clien
t. The Host owns Agents, models, tools, and Sessions; the TUI owns input, themes, panels, and termin
al rendering. Closing the TUI detaches it while Host work continues.
This development branch targets official Harness `0.2.2-rc.1`. The published Mayfly `0.1.4-rc.2` is
the immutable reference for appearance, keys, and workflows. Shared presentation is being carried in
to the split runtime; complete visual parity still requires the acceptance described in split valida
e split runtime; complete visual parity still requires the acceptance described in split validation.
## Unified command

After a matching release is published, install `@ephemeral-ai/mayfly-cli` globally and use `mayfly`
and `mayfly server start|stop|restart|status|logs|enable|disable|upgrade`. Linux uses systemd user s
ervices, macOS LaunchAgents, and Windows a hidden Mayfly supervisor. Login startup is opt-in. Data d
efaults to `~/.mayfly`, with `MAYFLY_HOME` overriding it; credentials are exchanged through private
local discovery. See the CLI manual for instances, logs, remote connections and lifecycle limits.
Upgrade the external CLI after stopping the old Host and backing up `MAYFLY_HOME`, then run `mayfly
server upgrade` on the original profile to retain its Sessions. CLI-managed linked profiles use this
explicit installer path; `/update` cannot upgrade them. See upgrades and existing data for the exac
t commands, rollback, and the old `~/.dsh` boundary.
## Native development startup
Use Node `>=24.9.0`, pinned pnpm `11.7.0`, and an isolated official dsh `0.2.2-rc.1` executable. The
se split packages are development artifacts; install from this checkout or verified release tarballs
. The installer checks the dsh version and keeps the global installation unchanged.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The installer builds the workspace, creates a dedicated profile from the native Web template, and ad
ds `@ephemeral-ai/mayfly-host`. It reuses an existing profile and rejects the shared `mayfly` and `d
efault` profiles. Launch both processes:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Model credentials, provider settings, permission presets, and session files belong to the Host. The
Host emits one `mayfly host: <url>` readiness line. Supply that authenticated URL through `MAYFLY_DS
H_STARTUP_URL`; the TUI rejects credentials in command-line arguments. `--host` accepts a non-secret
HTTP(S) URL while obtaining its token from the environment.
The TUI supports an initial task, an existing Session, and a Host working directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`MAYFLY_SESSION_ID`, `MAYFLY_CWD`, and `MAYFLY_TASK` provide defaults when corresponding arguments a
re absent. A launch without a task or resume id stays sessionless until the first prompt. `/new` and
`/clear` return to that start view without creating an empty Session or stopping existing work. Reb
uild with `pnpm run build` after source edits; rerun the installer when the dependency graph changes
. The unified CLI uses this same TUI entry after starting and discovering its local background Host.
## Use the TUI
The shared layout contains the conversation, activity and notification rows, editor, and status/view
s lane. It renders Markdown tables, closed Mermaid fences, tool cards, file diffs, approvals, and qu
estions. Theme changes preserve the native editor's draft, cursor, undo, history, paste, and complet
ion state. `/theme custom <path> [<base theme>]` reads a palette on the TUI machine; `/theme` change
s live presentation without saving the Host's default. Use `/settings` or onboarding to change persi
on without saving the Host's default. Use `/settings` or onboarding to change persisted preferences.
`/help` and slash completion reflect the selected Host's actual command catalog and the mounted loca
l features. A writable Session adds native Host commands; readonly views do not advertise writable c
ommands. Canonical command names remain singular: `/model`, `/provider`, `/preset`, and `/plugin`.
| Workflow | Commands and behavior |

rectly. `/rename <title>` renames the selected Session. `/fork` creates and selects a branch at the
current native fork boundary; extra arguments are ignored. `/rewind` opens the reference earlier-tur
n picker with prompt/response previews and creates a selected branch while preserving the original S

pt/response previews and creates a selected branch while preserving the original Session. |

## Architecture and extensions
The release set contains four packages:
| Package | Responsibility |
| `@ephemeral-ai/mayfly-host` | Native Host composition, durable Mayfly projections, generated `mayf

lyHost` Remote methods, and the DTOs and conversation fold the TUI imports. |
| `@ephemeral-ai/mayfl
y` | The independent TUI: official Client transport, Host/Session selection, feature controllers, re
nderer, themes, and editor/transcript controllers. Its public surface is the root, `./client`, and `

./bin`; no Host plugin, dsh bundle, patch, or preset payload is published. |
| `@ephemeral-ai/mayfly

-ui` | Renderer-neutral node contracts, builders, and the four UI services/provider. |
| `@ephemeral
-ai/mayfly-cli` | Unified CLI for background Host management and independent TUI startup. |
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Host plugins are ordinary Cordis plugins using documented native dsh services. TUI plugins contribut
e nodes through `mayflyPanes`, `mayflyStatus`, `mayflyOverlays`, and `mayflyEditorExtensions` in the
TUI's own Cordis tree; a source composition passes them to `run(argv, { plugins })` from `@ephemera
l-ai/mayfly/bin`, as `examples/mayfly-ecosystem` does. A plugin needing Host state uses the official
Client/Remote protocol and serializable DTOs; Agent, Session, Tool Definition, callbacks, and rende
rer objects never cross processes. The removed in-process `mayflyCurrentAgent` and app/interaction e
ntries are not public extension APIs. Architecture and service seams describe the current boundaries
